name: 3D printed car key fob protective shell

mentions.name: 3D printed car key fob protective shell
mentions.description: A 3D printed protective shell designed to fit over the author's car key fob so its buttons can never be pressed accidentally, created as one of the author's small practice projects for learning 3D scanning and printing.
mentions.problem: The author keeps leaning on the key fob and accidentally setting off the car alarm.
mentions.source_excerpt: I want to 3D print a shell that goes over my car fob: I keep leaning on it and setting off the alarm. The shell would make sure the buttons never get pushed.
